• *Marie Emilie Coignet de Courson (1716–1806) with a Dog* by Jean Honoré Fragonard (Oil on canvas, ca. 1769) – currently on view in Gallery 631.

• *Boy with Greyhound Dog* by John William Casilier (Graphite, pen, ink, and watercolor on paper, 1979) – a sketch that depicts a boy with a greyhound.
